capabilities: Autofocus the editor when a note opens
Select the first-line heading for quick renaming
Limit autofocus to notes with fewer than three lines
extras: The author asks users to let them know if they use the plugin; behavior is conditional (only notes under 3 lines, heading selection only on the first line).
motivation: The author wants creating new notes to be easy and efficient by skipping entering a name in the tab title bar.
problem: When opening a new note, the focus stays on the tab title bar, forcing an extra step of clicking into the editor before typing.

relations.evidence: It works best with Filename heading sync to make creating new notes easy and efficient

summary: Autofocuses the editor when a note is opened, and selects the first heading so new notes can be renamed immediately.
